workload_scope: local Ollama model-server duration; may include CPU offload; not pure GPU kernel time

threshold_study.selection_rule: Minimize mean across calibration workloads of 0.5*(overall mean / SRPT mean) + 0.5*(Correction p95 / SRPT Correction p95); ties choose smaller T. Freeze before evaluation. Same original question pool, disjoint arrival seeds.

rescue_study.selection_rule: Minimize arithmetic mean of paired overall-mean latency ratios to plain SRPT across calibration workloads. SRPT no-rescue is eligible with score 1. Finite challenger selected independently for comparison; tie prefers larger T. T candidates = ceil pooled post-warmup SRPT cumulative wait p90/p95/p99 across all calibration loads/seeds. No correction weight.

tradeoff_study.selection: None: report every prespecified T; descriptive dominance at each load, not final holdout tuning
